estimates: The model covers the Maqam mosque, its external hall wings, public court and principal outer gateway. Administration, service buildings, the well pavilion and interiors are outside the scope.
The five dome footprints and mapped heights control the roofs. Placement and diameter for the two tall pairs of minarets, tile designs, arch proportions and crown ornaments are estimated.
The independent terrain gives approximate grade. Fine paving, smaller windows and temporary structures are generalized.

review.notes: Reviewed the published Jamkaran image set first. Applicable architecture photographs are share-alike. The cleared photo shows the Prophet’s Mosque in Medina. Maps and written architectural surveys establish the reconstruction.
